verdict.rationale: Conductor explicitly supports running multiple underlying agent/model providers (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) and lets users pick a 'loadout' of favorite models with keyboard shortcuts to switch between them, plus bring-your-own subscriptions/keys for pricing flexibility. Community comments confirm multi-agent support and requests for even more providers (Gemini, Amazon Q) suggest it's a genuine differentiator already partially met. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of seamless mid-session switching, and some users note provider-specific 'feel' differences suggesting switching isn't perfectly transparent.
